描述_EN: both pattern and technique indicate the early date; the wyvern (a winged two legged dragon), eagles and palmettes are part of the repertoire of design absorbed into italian silk weaving from the byzantine and isalmic near east and as far away as china in some cases. a small group of fantastical silks like this one survive, with figures of real or imaginary birds and animals, sometimes enclosed in circles or geometric compartments. technically and stylistically, this silk also resembles those woven in spain at this time. this may have come from an ecclesiastical source, from which most early textiles survive, but silks like these were also used for dress and furnishings. these are very early examples of silks woven in italy.
描述_ZN: both pattern and technique indicate the early date; the wyvern (a winged two legged dragon), eagles and palmettes are part of the repertoire of design absorbed into italian silk weaving from the byzantine and isalmic near east and as far away as china in some cases. 有一小批像这样的幻想丝绸存世，有真实的或想象的鸟类和动物形象，有时被包围在圆圈或几何格子里。 在技术和风格上，这种丝绸也类似于此时在西班牙编织的丝绸。 这可能是来自于一个教会的来源，大多数早期的纺织品都来自于此，但像这样的丝绸也被用于服装和家具。 这些是在意大利编织的非常早期的丝绸的例子。
